name: PalQuest / Palestinian Journeys
pattern: Historical encyclopedia with chronology, stories and documents
lesson: Connect historical context to named source records; provide Arabic and English entry points.

name: Palestine Remix
pattern: Long chronology linked to documentary material
lesson: Offer an overview and deeper documentary paths without making video mandatory.

name: MSF Gaza Inside the War
pattern: Witness-based medical chronology documented by its publisher
lesson: Place testimony, medical infrastructure and date coverage together; distinguish field observations from editorial interpretation.

name: Palestine Online history timeline
pattern: Legacy image timeline with clickable markers
lesson: Never make an image map or obsolete frame layout the only way to access chronology.

name: Mapping the Nakba
pattern: Publisher source repository documents event selection and map highlighting
lesson: Synchronize selected moments with geography, and cite the underlying boundary and event datasets.

name: Palestine Solidarity at Sea
pattern: Chronological archive of solidarity activity
lesson: Keep a focused thematic path connected to the broader historical record.

name: USHMM Holocaust Timeline Activity
pattern: Multiple layers for policy, events and individual profiles
lesson: Allow readers to follow individual experiences beside institutional actions without implying that proximity proves causality.

name: Montreal Holocaust Museum maps and timelines
pattern: Timeline and map learning resources
lesson: Connect geography and sequence while preserving a reading alternative.

name: Anne Frank House timeline
pattern: Publisher documentation of a personal and historical timeline
lesson: Keep a person's life legible in its wider historical setting; treat the documented interface separately from verified current behavior.

name: Wiener Library / The Holocaust Explained
pattern: Timeline-assisted educational navigation
lesson: Make orientation instructions visible and short; link learning paths to archival material.

name: PBS Sugihara
pattern: Text-only version of an interactive chronology
lesson: Preserve equivalent dates, sources and narrative in a durable plain reading view.

name: Jewish Congregation Archives of Hamburg
pattern: Archive history timeline using quotations
lesson: Show how an archive itself was displaced and preserved, with attributed voices and custodial history.

name: JDC Archives Our Stories
pattern: Topic, location, decade and interactive timeline routes
lesson: Different entry routes should converge on the same identifiable source records.

name: R-Shief
pattern: Social-media archive with an institutional history timeline
lesson: Separate the history of the collection from the history represented by its contents.

name: AAPB Freedom Song / Eyes on the Prize
pattern: Timeline, map, essays and unedited interviews documented by the archive
lesson: Let polished interpretation lead back to original interviews and collection context.

name: SAHA oral history virtual exhibition
pattern: Interactive timeline connecting learners' oral histories
lesson: Use testimony with consent, attribution and context; provide transcripts for audio.

name: South African History Online timelines
pattern: Era and category routes into historical timelines
lesson: Expose historical eras and themes as explicit choices instead of a single enormous date control.

name: National Archives Milestone Documents
pattern: Publisher describes a timeline linking primary-source documents
lesson: Make the document and its archival identity one step from the historical moment.

name: National Archives Presidential Timeline
pattern: Legacy multimedia archive across presidential libraries
lesson: Avoid platform dependencies that can orphan a valuable chronology; keep structured exports and fallback access.

name: Library of Congress Battle of the Bulge
pattern: Daily situation maps with interactive and printable chronology
lesson: A visual sequence needs an equivalent printable record and clear document dates.

name: Library of Congress Songs of America
pattern: Music, cultural context and historical chronology
lesson: Parallel thematic contexts can explain a moment without merging distinct kinds of evidence.

name: Chronicling America map and timeline
pattern: Time slider, geographic map and collection coverage charts
lesson: Label coverage density as digitized material, never as the frequency of historical events.

name: Smithsonian Institution Archives timeline
pattern: Dated milestones with archival images
lesson: Use consistent dates, image credits and source links for every moment.

name: Smithsonian Human Origins timeline
pattern: Interactive evidence across long spans
lesson: Change temporal granularity deliberately and label it; do not imply uniform precision.

name: Smithsonian Time and Navigation
pattern: Innovation chronology with object credits
lesson: Give every image or object its own provenance rather than borrowing the event citation.

name: Smithsonian American Experience in the Classroom
pattern: Artwork-based historical timeline and teaching resources
lesson: Let an object or artwork open more than one interpretation and source path.

name: Smithsonian Oh Freedom!
pattern: Publisher documents artwork chronology with biographies and recordings
lesson: Relate people, culture and policy through attributed artifacts, not just headline milestones.

name: Met Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History
pattern: Time, geography, essays and collection objects
lesson: Connect chronological exploration to essays and object records without overwhelming the first screen.

name: New Museum Digital Archive chronology
pattern: Year navigation, record types and linked records
lesson: A chronological view should share the archive's record identities and filters.

name: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum timeline
pattern: Medium filtering and links to detailed collection objects documented by the museum
lesson: Filter a dense collection while retaining provenance and richer object information.

name: Robert McLaughlin Gallery collection timeline
pattern: Publisher tutorials for timeline and personal collections
lesson: Provide a brief learn-by-doing explanation and support saving source selections.

name: Gallup New Deal Art Virtual Museum
pattern: Timeline as one of several interpretive exhibit routes
lesson: Let visitors choose a route without making one narrative the exhaustive archive.

name: Illinois State Museum abstraction timeline
pattern: Collection-based learning journey with historical timeline
lesson: Pair specialist concepts with readable explanations and authentic collection examples.

name: Exploratorium 40th anniversary
pattern: Anniversary archive links an interactive timeline with podcasts
lesson: Keep optional media secondary to navigation and maintain legacy content access.

name: Northampton Museums history timeline
pattern: Objects and stories across a long chronology
lesson: Allow curated expansion and public contributions through a review process.

name: Brick Store Museum Kennebunk history
pattern: Timeline alongside exhibitions and oral histories
lesson: Make chronological browsing one route into a broader collection, with clear return paths.

name: DC History Center timeline
pattern: Community and civic milestones
lesson: Include local life and social struggles beside formal political milestones.

name: The Valentine Richmond history
pattern: Named eras and events tied to museum objects
lesson: Explain eras in ordinary language and show the object or document supporting an event.

name: LancasterHistory learning tools
pattern: Interactive timeline within a learning-resource collection
lesson: Give teachers a coherent route and a source-rich reading alternative.

name: Memphis Public Libraries bicentennial
pattern: Civic chronology drawn from library holdings
lesson: Balance hardship, community agency, culture and everyday history.

name: 9/11 Memorial and Museum
pattern: Museum documents a sensitive multimedia timeline
lesson: Give specific content notices and visitor control before disturbing media is displayed.

name: Pentagon Memorial 9/11 chronology
pattern: Several flights and locations in a shared day chronology
lesson: Keep simultaneous threads identifiable with labels and redundant visual cues.

name: 9/11 National Memorial Trail
pattern: Flight map linked to explicit times and time zone
lesson: Show clock precision and time zone when minute-level sequencing matters.

name: Royal Hampshire Regiment Museum
pattern: Museum entry point links interactive institutional chronology
lesson: Keep chronology beside research access and explain the route to collection records.

name: National Army Museum India, Empire and the Army
pattern: More than 200 sources across images, documents, objects and personal stories
lesson: Use mixed media as supporting evidence and supply teaching context.

name: National Army Museum First World War
pattern: Event chronology with dates and short descriptions
lesson: Make titles and summaries readable before asking for interaction.

name: Reserve Bank of Australia From Bank to Battlefield
pattern: Timeline linked to letters, profiles and an honor roll
lesson: Connect institutional chronology to people and correspondence; plan for script failure.

name: National Museum of Australia Encounters
pattern: Indigenous cultures and contact chronology
lesson: Historical periodization should acknowledge cultural perspectives and unequal evidence coverage.

name: National Museum of Australia Defining Moments
pattern: Museum documents an interactive classroom history timeline
lesson: Provide a first-time learning path separate from comprehensive browsing.

name: Scottish Parliament timeline
pattern: Interactive years with printable versions
lesson: Maintain print and language access alongside interactive navigation.

name: New Zealand Parliament timeline
pattern: Short text and images across 100 dates
lesson: Favor consistent concise entries and links to deeper context.

name: Scotland history portal
pattern: Time-period selection and category filtering
lesson: Date controls and topic filters need a single shared result state.

name: Marine Institute interactive archive
pattern: Historical fisheries reports with chronology and catch trends
lesson: Keep source-document counts and measured real-world quantities separate.

name: Casino Model Railway Museum Irish rail
pattern: Historical narrative with interactive timeline
lesson: Offer prose context before granular exploration.

name: UCD Decade of Centenaries
pattern: Scholarly chronology linked to commemorative resources
lesson: Show editorial scope and connect moments to fuller scholarship.

name: Open University History of Ireland
pattern: Embedded educational chronology with device advice
lesson: Design a genuine portrait mobile view instead of requiring rotation.

name: Irish Tape
pattern: Publisher describes sourced chronological moments on desktop and mobile
lesson: Use cinematic presentation only when orientation, sources and device usability survive.

name: Historic England Heritage Schools
pattern: Interactive national chronology plus downloadable and local materials
lesson: Connect overview history to local evidence and reusable classroom formats.

name: Texas Beyond History Ransom Williams
pattern: Local, state and national event layers around a family's history
lesson: Let readers move between the person, place and policy scales.

name: Civil War on the Western Border
pattern: Primary sources, scholarship, map and interactive chronology
lesson: Make event interpretation traceable to a distributed archival collection.

name: Ozarks Community and Conflict
pattern: Digital photo archive and thematic interactive timeline
lesson: Keep community experiences visible within large-scale conflict history.

name: PBS Ken Burns Civil War
pattern: Multimedia documentary chronology with readable event text
lesson: Do not let a visual date system hide approximate or year-only dates behind January 1 placeholders.

name: Freedom to Grow Soil of Resistance
pattern: Memory-keeping chronology of incarceration and resistance
lesson: Center community strategy, care and agency, not only institutional violence.

name: Berkeley Othering and Belonging 400 Years
pattern: Embedded chronology with an explicit source acknowledgment list
lesson: Provide item-level citations in addition to project-wide bibliography.

name: University of Michigan Spectrum Center
pattern: Local and national LGBTQIA2S+ chronology with media and historical terms
lesson: Preserve historically specific language with context and link campus history to broader developments.

name: NYC LGBT Community Center National History Archive
pattern: Community archive with timeline and research access
lesson: Show how to consult original holdings after discovering a story online.

name: Black Brandeis Black History
pattern: Archive collective documents its history timeline
lesson: Show who shaped a collection and whose histories it aims to recover.

name: Pacific Lutheran University Archives
pattern: Institutional, Black and queer history timeline routes
lesson: Offer distinct community lenses over shared archival resources without flattening them into one narrative.

name: Towson University Archives
pattern: Interactive university chronology
lesson: Keep the chronology connected to its archive and research service.

name: Aston University Archives history
pattern: Interactive timeline and audio history created from university records
lesson: Offer audio as an optional parallel route and expose archival origins.

name: University of Utah ARPANET Project
pattern: Focused interactive chronology with source context
lesson: Declare a bounded date range and explain which sources shaped the selection.

name: Emporia State Special Collections
pattern: Growing set of historical timelines
lesson: Name authorship, maintenance responsibility and links to further archival research.

name: University of Nebraska history
pattern: Publisher documents events, people, organizations and discoveries
lesson: Avoid assuming every timeline entry must be an event; type the underlying entity.

name: University of Illinois Mapping History
pattern: Multilayer history by eras, themes and archival maps
lesson: Keep spatial evidence optional and distinguish existing features from planned enhancements.

name: Texas Woman's University Archives
pattern: Embedded timeline with full-screen alternative
lesson: Embedded views need an escape to a usable standalone experience.

name: Harvard Asia Center Memories and Milestones
pattern: Exhibit chronology invites overlooked memories and contributions
lesson: A living record needs reviewed contributions and a correction path.

name: Gallaudet history and traditions
pattern: Chronology routes linked to archives and Deaf history collections
lesson: Support language, modality and community-specific access needs from the beginning.

name: Robert Gordon's College archive timeline
pattern: Archivist-built chronology with paintings, photographs and videos
lesson: Credit the curatorial author and retain individual media context.

name: University of Leeds IIIF exhibition timeline
pattern: Library documents TimelineJS entries embedding IIIF exhibitions
lesson: Separate media presentation from durable manifests, rights and collection identifiers.

name: University of Toronto discovery of insulin
pattern: Original notebooks, correspondence and archival objects with a chronological summary
lesson: Make summary-to-original-document navigation explicit and preserve document-level provenance.

name: University of Toledo Medicine on the Maumee
pattern: Virtual exhibit with timeline, videos and research links
lesson: Provide several reading depths and preserve permissions and attribution.

name: Sindecuse Museum Women Dentists
pattern: History timeline with individual professional profiles
lesson: Pair structural change with named people and lives.

name: James Madison University women's rights
pattern: Publisher describes timeline, photographs and yearbook material
lesson: Use ordinary artifacts as meaningful evidence of institutional and social change.

name: Evanston Women and the 19th
pattern: Biographical chronology and digitized documents
lesson: Let a person's path open documentary records and the wider movement.

name: National Women's History Museum online exhibits
pattern: Multiple historical timeline and exhibit routes
lesson: Name each route's scope, and link chronology to biographies and teaching resources.

name: Carnegie Hall African American Music timeline
pattern: Scholarly music chronology with archival media
lesson: Connect thematic strands with editorial credits and optional audio.

name: National Arts Centre NACmusicbox
pattern: Publisher documents recordings within a music-history timeline
lesson: Give audio explicit controls, contextual dates and a readable equivalent.

name: Oxford Grove Music history
pattern: Publishing-history chronology
lesson: Distinguish dates of editions and publications from dates of the subjects described.

name: Fortepan US
pattern: Timeline/grid switching, date range, photo identifiers and downloads
lesson: Preserve the same selection when changing views, and keep identifiers visible.

name: David Rumsey Map Collection
pattern: MapRank time and place filters plus collection browsing
lesson: Provide exact date inputs alongside a range control and connect geographic selection to dated sources.

name: George Mason Immigrants and America 250
pattern: Population data, policy and notable people in an interactive chronology
lesson: Keep measured datasets, legislation and biographical material in distinct labeled layers.

name: Pier 21 immigration and Indigenous history
pattern: Partner documents an integrated migration chronology
lesson: Periodization must include Indigenous histories and explain different perspectives.

name: KQED immigration history
pattern: Editorial interactive policy chronology
lesson: Explain the consequences of policy changes and show links to original sources.

name: Brown Choices immigration policy
pattern: Educational chronology with media and learning objectives
lesson: Disclose selective coverage and avoid treating omitted people as historically unimportant.

name: Brown Choices Black activism
pattern: Multimedia movements and individuals over time
lesson: Support a guided overview that still permits independent exploration.

name: HeinOnline American Worker
pattern: Legal collection with labor-organizing chronology
lesson: Keep legal interpretation linked to full-text cases and explain access restrictions.

name: Commonwealth Institute labor in Virginia
pattern: Thematic history timeline and map
lesson: Show the social and geographic setting of policy while keeping map controls optional.

name: Recollection Civil Rights Legal Archive
pattern: Archivists' association documents timeline, essays and biographies
lesson: A chronology should open both legal source material and biographical context.

name: Ludwig Leichhardt letters / Environment and Society
pattern: Letters and life events in a chronology with links to full documents
lesson: Keep letter-writing date, narrated event date and publication date separate.

name: Australian National Maritime Museum Cape Keerweer
pattern: Time-enabled map of changing trade routes
lesson: Temporal map state needs a legend and equivalent textual explanation of changes.
